title: 第13章 不讲武德第14章 龙的逆鳞
slug: 斗罗之张三的逆袭人生
content_zh:
阿斯里见张三依旧居高临下一脸不屑的看着自己，心中怒火再起，不禁又想要报复张三。
可真要他冲上去殴打张三，这个结果不出意外应该会反过来，所以他这边唯一能欺负的也只有可怜的柔媚了。
而且阿斯里知道张三来这里是为了救下自己手上的那个女孩。
所以他心道自己通过惩罚柔媚，应该可以惩戒这个嚣张的家伙。
可杀人，他确实有些不敢，但他也知道，自己胁迫的方式可以不只是威胁这个女孩的生命而已。
“你再不下来，我就把她脸划了！”
阿斯里将剑刃抬到柔媚的脸颊上，柔媚的表情比之前更为惊恐，原因无他，女孩的容貌可以说是她们最重要的事物之一，如果脸上留下什么伤疤，那绝不是什么小事。
“哦？”
张三发出一声轻笑，然后微微摇了摇头。
看似他并不在意，然而张三内心却也开始绷紧，同时也不由得想着这个面容尚还稚嫩的男孩究竟经历过什么，怎么内心戾气如此之重？
当然这都是次要的，关键还是要将这家伙稳住。
“你似乎误会了什么，我和你手上这家伙可不认识，我纯粹只是路过而已。”
张三一边说着，一边摸着身下那名矮瘦男孩的口袋，一副优哉游哉的模样，当他从袋中拿出一枚铜魂币后，就将之放在手中细细把玩，甚至没有看向阿斯里，倒是认真研究起这钱币上的纹理来。
“你就算杀了她，又与我何干？”
“哦？！是这样吗？”
阿斯里听这话，感到有些不可置信，感情他们真的只是被一个路人给搅黄了好事吗？
可张三的样子确实见不到半分紧张，似乎他真的是一点也不关心那女孩的生死。
若真是如此，那他不论对着女孩做什么，怕是都不能让这个人有半点触动。
然而就算如此，阿斯里也是要向柔媚的脸上割一刀子，用这女孩的惨叫，来试试看看张三的反应。
就在阿斯里准备挥剑时，张三突然开口说道：“不过……”

见张三有反应，阿斯里立刻得意的说道：
“怎么？你怕了？”
“啊？这你想多了。”
张三嗤笑一声，同时顺便将这枚硬币在指尖转了一个圈。
“我现在担心的，是你们。”
“我们？”
阿斯里一听有些不明就里，在他想说什么之前，张三就轻笑一声继续说道：
“你们可是被武魂殿选中的魂师候选，武魂殿对魂师的品行可一贯是要好好考核，以免手头培育的魂师误入歧途，变作无恶不作的邪魂师。”
“什么？”
阿斯里十分诧异，他还是第一次听到这种说法。
“你不会以为你们现在的所作所为，是在给你们日后在武魂学院加分吧？”
张三看到了阿斯里眼中的动摇，他笑了笑，并把手中这枚铜魂币抛向空中，再将之接住。
而阿斯里的目光不由得落在张三这个动作上，但是这些动作又好像没意义，就转移视线继续盯着张三的双眼，他试图看穿张三的想法，并在此时说道：
“成了魂师，不就想干嘛就干嘛？你说的我从来没有听过。”
content_en:
When Asri saw Zhang San still looking at him with a condescending look on his face, Asri became angry again and couldn't help but want to take revenge on Zhang San.
But if he really wanted to rush up and beat Zhang San, the result would be the other way round, so the only person he could bully was poor Roumei.
And Asri knew that Zhang San came here to save the girl in his hands.
So he thought that by punishing Roumei, he should be able to punish this arrogant guy.
But he did not dare to kill someone, but he also knew that his method of coercion could go beyond just threatening the girl's life.
"If you don't come down, I'll slash her face!"
Asri raised the sword blade to Rou Mei's cheek. Rou Mei's expression was more frightened than before. For no other reason than a girl's appearance can be said to be one of the most important things to them. If there are any scars on her face, it is by no means a trivial matter.
"Oh?"
Zhang San chuckled, then shook his head slightly.
It seemed that he didn't care, but Zhang San's heart began to tighten. At the same time, he couldn't help but think about what this boy with a still immature face had experienced, and why was he so angry inside?
Of course, these are all secondary, the key is to stabilize this guy.
"You seem to have misunderstood something. I don't know the guy you have. I was just passing by."
As Zhang San spoke, he touched the pocket of the short and skinny boy under him, looking carefree. When he took out a copper soul coin from the bag, he put it in his hand and played with it carefully. He didn't even look at Asri, but carefully studied the texture on the coin.
"Even if you kill her, what does it have to do with me?"
"Oh?! Is that so?"
When Asri heard this, he felt a little unbelievable. Were their feelings really just messed up by a passerby?
But Zhang San didn't look at all nervous. It seemed that he really didn't care about the girl's life or death at all.
If that's the case, then no matter what he does to the girl, he probably won't be able to touch her in the slightest.
However, even so, Asri still wanted to cut Roumei's face with a knife and use the girl's screams to test Zhang San's reaction.
Just when Asri was about to swing his sword, Zhang San suddenly said: "But..."
Seeing Zhang San's reaction, Asri immediately said proudly:
"What? Are you scared?"
"Huh? You're overthinking this."
Zhang San sneered and turned the coin in a circle on his fingertips.
"It's you I'm worried about now."
"Us?"
Asri was a little confused when he heard this. Before he wanted to say anything, Zhang San chuckled and continued:
"You are soul master candidates selected by Wuhun Palace. Wuhun Palace always evaluates the character of soul masters carefully to prevent the soul masters they are cultivating from going astray and becoming evil soul masters who do all kinds of evil."
"What?"
Asri was very surprised. This was the first time he heard this statement.
"You don't think that what you are doing now is to gain points for you in Wuhun Academy in the future, right?"
Zhang San saw the wavering in Asri's eyes, he smiled, threw the copper soul coin in his hand into the air, and then caught it.
Asri's eyes couldn't help but fall on Zhang San's actions, but these actions seemed meaningless, so he shifted his gaze and continued to stare at Zhang San's eyes. He tried to see through Zhang San's thoughts, and said at this time:
"When you become a soul master, don't you just do whatever you want? I've never heard of what you said."
